description: Replace one listener definition by zero-based index. Use persist=true to write the resulting config to disk.

listener.description:
A local listener definition that binds to a local address and port.

When TLS is enabled, the listener terminates TLS and routes based on SNI.
When TLS is disabled, the listener accepts plain HTTP and routes based on
the Host header.

All listeners share the same routes as the cruma ingress.

anyOf.description: Bind to 127.0.0.1 (loopback only, not accessible from the network).
Bind to 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces, accessible from the network).

addr.description: Bind address: localhost-only or all interfaces.

bind_ip.description:
Optional concrete local IP to bind instead of the preset localhost/all pair.

When set, the listener binds exactly this address and `addr` is used
only for locality/display semantics.

anyOf.description: Use self-signed certificates (default, good for local development).

Use ACME TLS-ALPN-01 to obtain real certificates from Let's Encrypt.
Requires the listener port to be reachable from the internet on port 443.

Legacy alias for `AcmeAlpn`.

Previously this meant "inherit the cert mode from each frontend route",
but per-frontend `cert_mode_overrides` now always take precedence over
the listener setting regardless of which listener mode is chosen, making
this option redundant.  Kept for backward-compatibility with existing
config files; treated identically to `AcmeAlpn` in all new code.

http3.description:
Whether HTTP/3 (QUIC) should be enabled for this HTTPS listener.

Ignored for plain HTTP and virtual `cruma` listeners.

kind.description:
Listener kind.

When omitted, legacy compatibility rules apply and `tls` decides:
`tls: true` => HTTPS, `tls: false` => HTTP.

max_connections.description:
Maximum number of concurrent TCP connections accepted on this listener.

Connections that arrive when the limit is already reached are dropped
immediately. Leave unset for unlimited (bounded only by OS resources).

max_connections_per_ip.description:
Maximum number of concurrent TCP connections from a single source IP.

Connections from an IP that already has this many open connections are
dropped. Leave unset for no per-source limit.

port.description:
Port number to listen on (local HTTP/HTTPS listeners).

For `kind: cruma`, this is ignored.

request_limits.description: Optional request/header limits applied to all HTTP requests on this listener.

body_read_timeout_secs.description:
Maximum time, in seconds, the client may go **without sending any request
body bytes** before the request is aborted — an *idle* (not total)
timeout, so legitimate large uploads that keep making progress are never
cut off. Bounds slow-body attacks that send headers promptly then dribble
the body to hold a connection open. Opt-in: when unset, no body-read
timeout is enforced (request bodies may stall indefinitely, matching prior
behavior). A route may only tighten the listener's value.

header_read_timeout_secs.description:
Maximum time, in seconds, allowed for a client to send the complete
request header block. Bounds slow-header (slowloris) attacks that dribble
bytes to hold a connection open indefinitely. When unset, a built-in
default of [`DEFAULT_HEADER_READ_TIMEOUT_SECS`] applies. A route may only
tighten (never loosen) the listener's value.

max_header_bytes.description: Maximum aggregate header bytes across all parsed request headers.

max_header_name_bytes.description: Maximum bytes allowed for a single header name.

max_header_value_bytes.description: Maximum bytes allowed for a single header value.

max_request_body_bytes.description: Maximum accepted request body size in bytes.

tls.description:
Legacy compatibility field for older configs.

New configs should use `kind`. This field is still deserialized so old
configs keep working, but it is not serialized anymore.

name: update_listener
